calculation.description: For each tradable asset, rank the prior completed session's intraday return reversal: assets with weaker prior open-to-close performance receive higher scores. The one-session lag prevents look-ahead; cross-sectional winsorization limits isolated OHLC outliers.

validation.regime_notes: H10 IC remained positive in 2020-2023 (+0.007633), 2024-2026 (+0.008913), 2027-2029 (+0.016096), 2030-2032 (+0.001702), and 2033-2035 (+0.009997). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation; average N exceeded 14.7.
